scope: Current recipe study's26 eligible training parents and411 frozen tasks (208C20,203C40); audit and render existing geometry only.
user_intent: Prefer coherent local surfaces resembling user input; flag accidental fragments/spikes without treating all independent parts as bad.
assumption: Coherent local surface is provisional input profile; optional user preference remains pending.
resource_rationale: 24CPU,low WSL load,~19.5GiB Windows available; user Unreal GPU activity preserved. Existing small meshes fit CPU/RAM.
limits: Diagnostic flags are not automatic rejection. Boundary, source-index nonmanifold and multiple components do not alone imply bad user input. No semantic usability score invented. Preserve objective per-parent/per-condition records and actual AI review separately.
